integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 2D cel-shaded anime illustration with watercolor wash overlay on rice-paper texture, bold visible brushstrokes, high-saturation pop-art colors, fauvist expressive linework, punk-cute hybrid aesthetic, 1:1 square composition, ultra-high-definition 8K quality. A cheerful red-haired mascot girl with bouncy crimson curls tied into small braids, pink bow hair clips, smiley-face earrings, a colorful beaded necklace, and large sparkling golden pupils stands at the left edge of the frame in a half-body pose, her cute expression and flowing hair strands gently reaching toward and touching the text elements as decorative accompaniment. The background is a light beige rice-paper texture with pink hearts, stars, and doodle lines adorning all four corners. In the center of the frame, a massive headline reads “最新 ComfyUI” in thick hand-drawn graffiti lettering with bold black outlines, 3D drop shadows, and oversized scale, making the ComfyUI text dominate the visual hierarchy. Below it, a medium-large headline in colorful bold letters reads “MiniMax H3 全能参考”. Beneath that, a medium subtitle line reads “文生 首尾帧 多图参考 动作模仿 数字人 MV 漫剧”. In the upper-left corner, a hand-drawn flame sticker contains the text “一键安装 远程安装 一对一服务”. All text is crisp, legible, and prominently displayed. The young mascot girl (S1) waves one hand at the camera with a bright smile and says in a bubbly, energetic voice: [Chinese] 哈喽～我是你的 ComfyUI 小助手！最新 ComfyUI 一键安装，MiniMax H3 全能参考，文生视频、首尾帧、多图参考、动作模仿、数字人、MV、漫剧，全部搞定～可提供远程安装和一对一服务哦！本视频由MiniMaxH3生成。 [Shot 2] At 00:10.000, the camera cuts to a close-up of the mascot girl’s face as she winks one golden eye, makes a heart shape with both hands, and the text elements around her gently pulse with a soft glow while the corner doodles sparkle.

overall_soundscape: A light, airy paper-texture ambience with faint scribbling sounds as the doodle decorations subtly animate, the soft rustle of the mascot girl’s hair as it moves, and a gentle electronic shimmer as the text elements pulse.

non_diegetic_music: A bright, bouncy J-pop melody at 128 BPM with cheerful synth chords, a playful marimba lead, and a light electronic drum beat, energetic and cute throughout.

*添加image，video，audio对应加载节点，然后连接到MiniMax H3 参考生成视频节点中参考选项。*

For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description:

The target video is a vertical (9:16) short story shot from the protagonist's first-person perspective inside a Chinese metro car: the protagonist sits opposite a young woman, flicks through a clothing-app on his own phone, taps the JK sailor uniform set, and the woman across the bench is magically re-dressed into the selected outfit, leaving her startled — only her clothing changes, while her phone, bag, and all accessories stay untouched. The entire clip is one continuous single take with no cuts and no frame skips, keeping consistent exposure, stable lighting, and no flicker, with no subtitles and no readable text anywhere except the structural phone UI.
[Shot 1] The whole video from 0.00 to 10.00 seconds is a single unbroken take with one smooth, steady push-in camera movement and no cut points. At 0.00 seconds, the shot opens with the composition of <Picture 1>: in the foreground right, the protagonist's hand holds a smartphone showing the clothing-app page — the main display shows a JK sailor uniform outfit set with a white top, a red bow tie, and a black pleated skirt, with a row of clothing thumbnails below; in the background left, the young woman sits on the silver-gray stainless-steel bench, long brownish-red hair over her shoulders, wearing a light khaki shirt-jacket, a white pleated mini skirt, and white mid-calf socks, her head lowered over her own phone. Behind her, the metro window shows a blurred station platform with passersby, overhead grab rails, and a partially visible passenger at the right edge. The camera begins a very slow, smooth push-in; metro rolling ambience continues.
From 00:02.500 onward the camera keeps pushing in seamlessly toward the phone screen until it nearly fills the frame. The protagonist's thumb swipes left and right across the screen, and the clothing set images slide horizontally — the JK sailor uniform set, then other style sets, then back to the JK set — while the thumbnail strip scrolls in sync; the swipe and scroll motion is smooth and continuous. When the JK set returns to center, the thumb taps it once, and a soft circular touch ripple briefly appears at the tap point.
At 00:04.500, at the moment of the tap, a trail of soft magical light flows from the phone screen across the car to the woman, and a shimmering glow with light particles flows down her body from shoulders to hem; her light-khaki shirt-jacket and white pleated skirt dissolve and smoothly reshape into the JK sailor uniform from the phone — a white top, a red bow tie, and a black pleated skirt — while her face, hairstyle, seated pose, and bench position stay completely unchanged, and everything she carries also stays untouched: the phone held in her hands, her bag, and all small accessories are not affected by the magic. Only the clothing itself is transformed. The transformation is a continuous in-frame morph with no jump. The woman feels the change, lowers her head to look at her new clothes, and shows a startled expression with wide eyes and a slightly open mouth; the light particles settle and gently fade.
From 00:07.500 to 00:10.000, the camera keeps pushing in smoothly without stopping to a medium close-up as the woman raises her head and looks toward the camera (toward the protagonist) with a surprised, puzzled expression, touching the red bow tie and collar of the JK uniform with her free hand while still holding her phone in the other hand; the light particles finish fading, the camera settles to a steady hold, and the shot ends at 00:10.000.

overall_soundscape:

Continuous Chinese-metro interior ambience: a low rail rumble with soft rolling clatter, faint air-conditioning airflow, distant muffled station announcements, and occasional footsteps; the soft swish of the thumb swiping the screen, a light tap click, a gentle whoosh and fabric rustle at the magical outfit change, and the woman's startled gasp. No dialogue.

non_diegetic_music:

Light upbeat fashion-try-on background music, a soft electronic pop loop with gentle sparkling synth tones; subtle musical chime accents mark the swipe selection, the tap, and the completed outfit change, beginning softly shortly after the start, staying gentle so the metro ambience remains audible, and ending with a clean final chime.
